stock.description: Solartech International Holdings Ltd. functions as an investment holding entity primarily focused on the production and distribution of cables, wires, and copper rods. The company serves a wide geographical area, including mainland China, the Americas, Europe, Hong Kong, and various other Asian regions. Its specialized wiring and cabling products are predominantly supplied to manufacturers of white goods appliances. Beyond these core activities, Solartech is also engaged in the manufacturing and trading of plastic goods, property management, offering financial and managerial services, holding mining entitlements, and overseeing trademark portfolios. The firm's main corporate office is located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
